alt: The sender notifies the FCC that TracFone is sending boilerplate responses instead of technical resolutions, alleging Motorola Mobility LLC is responsible for device degradation due to hardcoded profiles and requesting the FCC compel Motorola to provide a software patch or replacement unit.
summary: The sender notifies the FCC that TracFone is sending boilerplate responses instead of technical resolutions, alleging Motorola Mobility LLC is responsible for device degradation due to hardcoded profiles and requesting the FCC compel Motorola to provide a software patch or replacement unit.
full_text: The sender notifies the FCC that TracFone is sending boilerplate responses instead of coordinating a technical resolution. He argues that Motorola Mobility LLC is responsible for the hardcoded profiles degrading the device and requests the FCC compel Motorola to provide an official software patch or replacement unit.
